observations: Photo 0 shows a small blue plastic toy shaped like a handheld fan/steering wheel with 5 colored piano-style keys, each decorated with a cartoon dog character labeled 'Bluey'.
A music-note icon and an orange ring/handle are visible, consistent with a children's toy, not a full-size keyboard.

Photo 1 shows the back of the same object: a battery compartment panel with small print (illegible model numbers) and a screw, plus the orange handle grip held by a hand for scale, confirming small toy size.
No display screen, no octave of keys, no power-adapter port, no speaker grille typical of an 'electronic piano' is visible in either photo.
The object's size relative to the adult hand holding it in photo 1 indicates it is a handheld toy, far smaller than any real keyboard/piano.
